request: Two notifier improvements on the same surface. A: notify when the session blocks on the human (AskUserQuestion / plan approval / permission prompt / idle input) — the moment the yield+stop modes miss. B: presence-aware suppression — when velocity.notifier.presence==aware, suppress the idle ping if the terminal is frontmost AND HID idle <= present_idle_seconds. macOS-first (ioreg HIDIdleTime + lsappinfo frontmost), fail-open elsewhere.
novelty_evidence: Pattern-copies the Stop-command wiring from commit 7dba960 (notifier-on-stop) for the new event wiring, but two surfaces are new: (1) the input-wait trigger needs the Claude Code Notification hook event (settings.json has NO Notification hook today; PreToolUse matchers are Bash and Write-family only), and (2) the macOS presence probe (ioreg HIDIdleTime + lsappinfo frontmost) has no in-repo precedent. Exact hook seam for A being confirmed via claude-code-guide.
